summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video ## Dress Making: How Many Steps Does It Take to Modify a T-Shirt into a Dress? ### Introduction In this tutorial, we will learn the method of making a dress, specifically how to modify a T-shirt into a dress. This is part five of our series, focusing on editing poses in Marvelous Designer. ### Adjusting the Model's Bone To begin, press **Shift-X** to display the X-Ray combination and adjust the model's bone. ### Symmetrical Edit Function Before making adjustments, click on the icon located in the upper right corner of the locator to activate the symmetrical edit function. Press the icon again to turn it off and make adjustments to the node separately. ### Returning to Normal Body Surface After selecting a node, press **Shift-X** again to return to the normal human body surface. This allows for simultaneous references and adjustments. ### Background Setup If the background is set to a default mirror color, you may not be able to see the bone grid. To resolve this, you can replace the background. In the 3D window background, right-click and select **Set 3D Background**. Choose the texture or color block to fill in as needed. ### Adjusting the Bone Grid Position Once the background is set, you can adjust the bone grid position as necessary. ### Morph Target Function If you are adjusting the posture using external software, you can utilize the **Morph Target** function. For a detailed explanation of how to use this function, please refer to the animation production video. ### Saving the Pose After completing the adjustments, you can save the current pose as a posture file for future use. This pose can be downloaded from the address provided in the shortcut. ### 3D Model Overview This is the first time I have utilized the Morph Target function. You will soon see that the model is now in the 3D world. ### Conclusion In the basic model, we can observe that the model is present in the 3D world. The model consists of three parts, showcasing the full complexity of the design process. The model is fully integrated into the 3D environment, and we are excited to explore its capabilities further. ```
